sn46.43:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the path crushing the army of Mara.
sn46.43:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path crushing the army of Mara?
sn46.43:1.7: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.43:1.8: This is the path crushing the army of Mara.”
